passive.name: One At A Time
passive.text: Increase the wearer's CRIT Rate by **18/21/24/27/30%** and increases DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATK by **30/35/40/45/50%**. After the wearer uses a Follow-Up ATK, inflicts the target with the "Tame" state, stacking up to **2** time(s). When allies hit enemy targets under the "Tame" state, each "Tame" stack increases the CRIT DMG dealt by **12/14/16/18/20%**.

passive.name: Answers of Their Own
passive.text: For each time the wearer hits the same target, DMG dealt increases by **8/10/12/14/16%**, stacking up to **5** time(s). This effect will be dispelled when the wearer changes targets.

passive.name: Chase
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **8/10/12/14/16%**, and increases their CRIT Rate against enemies with HP percentage **50%** or less by an extra **8/10/12/14/16%**. When the wearer defeats an enemy, their ATK is increased by **20/25/30/35/40%** for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Record
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **16/20/24/28/32%**. If there are 2 or fewer enemies on the field, increases wearer's CRIT Rate by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

passive.name: Wager
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **12/14/16/18/20%**. When the wearer lands a CRIT hit on enemies, gains 1 stack of Good Fortune. This can stack up to **4** time(s). Every stack of Good Fortune increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **8/9/10/11/12%**. Good Fortune will be removed at the end of the wearer's turn.

substatLine: SPD (breakpoint) > CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK%

entries.name: Deficit...
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **100%** of Topaz's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Difficulty Paying?
entries.text:
Inflicts one designated enemy target with a "Proof of Debt" state, increasing the Follow-Up ATK DMG it receives by **50%**. "Proof of Debt" only takes effect on the most recent target it is applied to. If there are no enemies inflicted with "Proof of Debt" on the field when an ally's turn starts or when an ally takes action, Topaz will inflict a random enemy with "Proof of Debt."
Numby deals Fire DMG equal to **150%** of Topaz's ATK to this target. Using this Skill to deal DMG is considered as launching a Follow-Up ATK.

entries.name: Turn a Profit!
entries.text: Numby enters the Windfall Bonanza! state and its DMG multiplier increases by **150%** and CRIT DMG increases by **25%**. Also, when enemies with Proof of Debt are hit by an ally's Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, Numby's action is Advanced Forward by **50%**. Numby exits the Windfall Bonanza! state after using **2** attacks.

entries.name: Trotter Market!?
entries.text:
Summons Numby at the start of battle. Numby has **80** SPD by default. When taking action, Numby launches Follow-Up ATKs on one enemy target afflicted with "Proof of Debt," dealing Fire DMG equal to **150%** of Topaz's ATK.
When enemies afflicted with "Proof of Debt" receive an ally's Follow-Up ATKs, Numby's action is Advanced Forward by **50%**. The action Advance Forward effect cannot be triggered during Numby's own turn.
When Topaz is downed, Numby disappears.

entries.name: Explicit Subsidy
entries.text:
Summons Numby when Topaz enters the overworld. Numby will automatically search for Basic Treasures and Trotters within a set radius.
Using her Technique will regenerate **60** Energy for Topaz after Numby's first attack in the next battle.
If Topaz is still in the team after using her Technique and defeating overworld enemies, a small bonus amount of credits will be added to the earned credits. A maximum of **10000** bonus credits can be received per calendar day.
After using her Technique and defeating enemies in Simulated Universe or Divergent Universe, additionally receive a small amount of Cosmic Fragments with a small chance to obtain 1 random Curio.

entries.name: Overdraft
entries.text: When Topaz uses Basic ATK to deal DMG, it is considered as a Follow-Up ATK.

entries.name: Financial Turmoil
entries.text: Increases Topaz & Numby's DMG dealt to enemy targets with Fire Weakness by **15%**.

entries.name: Stonks Market
entries.text: After Numby uses an attack while in the Windfall Bonanza! state, Topaz additionally regenerates **10** Energy.

entries.name: Future Market
entries.text:
When enemies afflicted with "Proof of Debt" receive Follow-Up ATKs, they will enter the "Debtor" state. This can take effect only once within a single attack.
The "Debtor" state increases the CRIT DMG of Follow-Up ATKs inflicted on the enemy target by 25%, stacking up to 2 time(s). When "Proof of Debt" is removed, the "Debtor" state is also removed.

entries.name: Bona Fide Acquisition
entries.text: After Numby takes action and launches an attack, Topaz regenerates 5 Energy.

entries.name: Seize the Big and Free the Small
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Agile Operation
entries.text: After Numby's turn begins, Topaz's action advances by 20%.

entries.name: Inflationary Demand
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Incentive Mechanism
entries.text: Numby's attack count during the "Windfall Bonanza!" state increases by 1, and its Fire RES PEN increases by 10% when it attacks.
